instruction: A warehouse starts with 2990 boxes. Then the stock is split equally into 3 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). It ships 149 boxes per day for 3 days. It receives 4 deliveries of 65 boxes each. It receives 3 deliveries of 69 boxes each. It ships 5 boxes per day for 3 days. How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
